capabilities.body: OpenAmer i planem wan wok, i mekem wetem ol tru tul — terminal, braosa, fael, kod — mo i holem wanem i wok gud.
capabilities.title: Wan ejen we i tingting wetem yu

capabilities.body: Ol storian, memori mo model oli stap long kompiuta ya. I no sanem wan samting i go antap sapos yu no askem.
capabilities.title: Kompiuta blong yu, data blong yu

capabilities.body: 186 lanwis, wanwan wetem kaen raeting we yu save ridim. Fas skrin blong ap i askem yu blong jusum wan.
capabilities.title: Lanwis blong yu, long stret fasin

capabilities.body: I sevem ol save blong mekem wok taem i stap wok, mekem se ol wok blong evri dei oli tekem smol taem moa taem yu yusum moa.
capabilities.title: Save blong mekem wok i stap gru

help: Jekem se kompiuta ya i save konek long intanet.
Statem rere bakegen — i no ripitim ol step we oli finis.
Sapos i fel tu taem, openem ol rekod; ol las laen oli talem step we i fel.
failure.lead: I no gat jenis we i bin tanem bak long haed — OpenAmer i stop long ples we i stop, mekem se taem yu statem bakegen, i gohed long ples ya.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer i stap yet long olfala vesin mo i gohed blong wok. I no gat samting we i jenis haf nomo.
failure.title: Rere i no finis

language.lead: Rere i gohed long lanwis we yu jusum long ples ya. Yu save jenisim afta insaed long ap.
language.title: Jusum lanwis blong yu

progress.lead: Rere wan taem nomo: OpenAmer i stap daonlodem wanem i nidim mo setemap kompiuta ya. Taem yu openem afta, i no mekem ol samting ya bakegen.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer i stap tekem ples blong olfala vesin. Ol sesen, memori mo seting blong yu oli stap semak.
progress.title: Stap setemap OpenAmer

stages.bootstrap-marker: Stap makem se instolesen i finis
stages.config-templates: Stap raetem ol templet blong seting
stages.configure: Stap setemap ol ki blong API mo ol model
stages.dependencies: Stap instolem ol pakij we Python i nidim
stages.node-deps: Stap instolem ol pakij we Node.js i nidim
stages.platform-sdks: Stap instolem ol SDK blong ol platfom blong mesej
stages.rebuild: Stap bildim ap blong kompiuta bakegen
stages.uv: Stap instolem uv we i manejem ol pakij
stages.venv: Stap mekem wan envaeromen blong Python we i stap hem wan

cards.body: Openem ap mo tokbaot wanem yu wantem blong i mekem. OpenAmer i wok long bakgraon mo i talem risalt long yu.
cards.title: Stat wetem wan sentens

cards.body: Ol seting → Displei → Lanwis. 186 lokel seting, yu save jenisim long eni taem.
cards.title: Jusum lanwis blong yu

cards.body: Wok we i ripit i kam wan save blong mekem wok — nekis taem wan oda nomo i naf.
cards.title: Letem i tingbaot

success.command: o statem afta long wan terminal:
success.errorTitle: I no save statem ap blong kompiuta
success.lead: Evri samting i rere. OpenAmer i blong yu nao — long kompiuta ya, long lanwis blong yu.
success.title: OpenAmer i rere

bullets: I wok long kompiuta blong yu — ol storian blong yu oli stap long kompiuta ya
186 lanwis, wetem kaen raeting we yu save ridim
Yu save jenisim evri samting afta; i no gat samting we i mas stap olsem oltaem
welcome.lead: Ejen blong yu nomo. Long kompiuta blong yu. Long lanwis blong yu.
welcome.leadUpdate: Wan niufala OpenAmer i rere. Hemia i tekem ples blong olfala vesin mo i kipim evri sesen mo seting.
welcome.note: I tekem sam minit long wan nomol koneksen.
welcome.title: Welkam long OpenAmer
